subject: Proposal: reallocate runtime headcount — convert senior IC slot to manager
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal: reallocate runtime headcount — convert senior IC slot to manager

Team —

Quick ask: I'd like approval to convert one open senior runtime SWE slot (IC5) in the Q2 slate into a 1.0 FTE manager / tech lead for the kernel/kernel-perf subteam. Rationale in short:

- We have three months of delivery risk on kernel optimizations without a dedicated technical lead; throughput regressions are starting to surface in canary pools.
- Hiring a strong manager now will unblock two ongoing MLPs (continuous batching and KV-cache compaction) and should reduce downstream SRE tickets by ~30% per our incident model.
- Cost-neutral on committed HC: the headcount remains 1.0 FTE. Budget impact is limited to banding/offer delta — estimated $25k on-target annual comp difference based on market/benchmarks. See attached cost_delta_model.xlsx.

Attachments: HC_slate_swap_v1.pdf (proposed slate update), cost_delta_model.xlsx, draft_manager_jd.docx.

Decision requested: approve the slot conversion and greenlight sourcing at L7-manager band (target level) so we can brief TalentPartners and extend a buffer offer in early March. Prefer an approval answer by EOD Wed (22 Feb) to keep timeline.

Thanks —
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Runtime Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Feb 2028 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: reallocate runtime headcount — convert senior IC slot to manager

Rishi —

Thanks for the write-up. A couple quick clarifying Qs from infra: 

- Can you quantify the delivery delta if we keep hiring an IC instead of a manager? You note a 30% reduction in SRE tickets; what's the expected timeline to that reduction?
- Who owns the candidate funnel if we convert the slot? Do we rely on TalentPartners + internal referrals or do you want dedicated EE sourcing?

I agree the kernel work needs ownership. My concern is ramp: an IC could start contributing faster (~8–10 weeks) vs manager (~12–16 weeks) for cross-team orchestration. If the manager will double as a technical lead troubleshooting perf regressions until we hire another senior IC, fine — want that spelled out in the JD.

Can you add a brief "ramp & mitigation" paragraph to the slate doc so we can present to SRE/infra owners?

— Marcus
VP, Platform Infra

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Feb 2028 13:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: reallocate runtime headcount — convert senior IC slot to manager

Rishi —

From finance/resource planning perspective we can approve the conversion as long as:

- The role remains within the existing HC tranche (no additional FTE authorization required).
- Total comp delta stays within ~$30k delta annually per grade (so your $25k estimate is acceptable).
- Recruiting commit: you confirm TalentPartners + 2 internal referrals + expedite pipeline; if external fees go above 15% we need pre-approval.

Please attach an updated JD with explicit responsibilities and the proposed band (L7 manager). Also include the hiring timeline and acceptance buffer (target offer window early March). Once I have that I can sign-off and move it through the payroll/comp band check.

Kimberly
Head of Finance & People Operations

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Feb 2028 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: reallocate runtime headcount — convert senior IC slot to manager

Thanks Rishi — pls see inline + next steps: 

- JD: I updated your draft_manager_jd.docx with a short candidate profile & must-haves (lead kernel teams at scale, prior quant perf experience, strong cross-functional stakeholder mgmt). Attaching updated file to the HR system this morning.
- Comp band: L7-manager band approved pending Kimberly's comp confirmation. We will need a hiring committee set (2 engineering + 1 people ops + 1 finance) for final sign-off; I can pull names once you confirm sourcing plan.
- External candidate: Alexei Novak (ref from TalentPartners) looks promising; shared resume in the ATS earlier.

Next steps for you: confirm the sourcing play (TalentPartners + 2 referrals), and indicate the buffer salary range we want TalentPartners to target (low/target/high). I'll draft the hiring committee invite and kick the ATS flow.

Marissa
Sr. Recruiting Partner

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Feb 2028 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: reallocate runtime headcount — convert senior IC slot to manager

Rishi / all —

I've reviewed the packet and the cost model. I approve converting the IC slot into a manager role (L7). Conditions:

- Recruiting executes the sourcing plan (TalentPartners + 2 internal referrals) and keeps external fees within Kimberly's threshold.
- Rishi to present the ramp plan at the weekly platform leadership sync (this Thurs) with target milestones for the first 90 days.
- Offer band: draft at the target L7-manager band with a $10k discretionary sign-on if necessary to close Alexei or other final candidates.

Proceed with sourcing and loop me once we have a final interview slate.

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
VP, Engineering
